description: Counts incoming triggers and fires a short pulse from eight outputs at eight different divisions of that count, every pulse passed or dropped by one probability setting

params.text: The chance a division fires when its turn comes round; nothing gets through at the far left, everything at the far right, and a freshly placed module is at mid travel

inputs.text: The triggers to be counted; every rising edge advances all eight dividers by one. The threshold is 2V rising and 0.1V falling
A rising edge here returns all eight counters to their starting positions and clears any pulse in progress; a trigger arriving at TRIG in that same sample is not counted

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V on every incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every second incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every third incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every fourth incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every fifth incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every sixth incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every seventh incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability
A 1ms pulse at 10V on every eighth incoming trigger, or nothing, according to the probability

notes: the probability is rolled separately for each division every time that division comes round, so the outputs drop pulses independently of one another
a freshly placed module has the probability at mid travel, so half the pulses are dropped before anything is patched; turn it fully clockwise for a plain divider
the lamp follows the voltage at TRIG

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
